intro: A washing machine that will not spin, a dishwasher that will not drain or an oven that has stopped heating. Below are 3 appliance repair firms in Leeds with strong Google reviews, what each one repairs and what to ask before they come out.
seo_title: Washing Machine Repair Leeds: 3 Appliance Engineers (2026)
seo_desc: Washing machine repair in Leeds from 3 local appliance engineers with strong Google reviews. Call out fees, repair or replace, brands and what to ask.
h1: Washing machine and appliance repair in Leeds: 3 local engineers
checks: Ask for the call out or diagnostic fee, and whether it is taken off the repair if you go ahead.
Ask them to quote for parts before fitting anything, so you can decide whether the repair is worth it.
Ask how long the repair is guaranteed for, and whether gas cookers are repaired by a Gas Safe registered engineer.

p: A repair is usually worth it when the appliance is fairly new and the repair costs much less than a replacement. A good engineer will tell you if a part costs more than the machine is worth. Ask for the diagnosis and the parts price before agreeing to the repair, and compare it with the price of a new machine fitted.

ul: Not draining: often a blocked pump filter or hose, which is a quick fix
Not spinning: can be an unbalanced load, the pump, the motor brushes or the drive belt
Leaking: often the door seal, a hose or the pump
Noisy when spinning: often worn drum bearings, which can cost more to fix
Not starting: the door lock, the control board or a blown fuse

guide.h2: Call out fees and what to ask
p: Most Leeds engineers charge a call out or diagnostic fee, and some take it off the bill if you go ahead. Check the price before they visit, and ask whether parts are carried on the van, which can mean a fix on the first visit.

Any work on a gas cooker or gas hob must be done by a Gas Safe registered engineer. If water is leaking from pipes rather than the machine, you may need a plumber, and a socket or circuit that keeps tripping is a job for an electrician.

ul: Check the plug, fuse and socket with another appliance
Clean the pump filter on a washing machine that will not drain
Note the make and model number, usually inside the door or on the back
Check whether the appliance is still under a manufacturer or extended warranty

faqs.q: How much does washing machine repair cost in Leeds?
faqs.a: It depends on the fault and the part. A&E Appliances in Leeds lists repairs from £45 plus VAT. Ask any engineer for the call out fee and a parts price before they start.

faqs.q: Is it worth repairing a washing machine?
faqs.a: Often, if the machine is fairly new and the repair costs much less than a replacement. Faults like a blocked pump filter or a worn door seal are usually cheap to fix, while drum bearings or a control board cost more.

faqs.q: Can you repair any brand of appliance?
faqs.a: Most independent engineers repair the common brands, such as Bosch, Hotpoint, Indesit, Beko, Samsung and LG. Ask when you book, as parts for some brands take longer to get.

faqs.q: Who can repair a gas cooker?
faqs.a: Only a Gas Safe registered engineer. Check the engineer's Gas Safe ID card and look them up on the Gas Safe Register before any gas work.

faqs.q: What should I check before calling out an engineer?
faqs.a: Check the plug and fuse, try the socket with another appliance and clean the pump filter if a washing machine will not drain. Have the make and model number ready when you call.
